title: Glyph atlas uploads race the render thread (thread_model 2)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.7 stable.

### System information

Windows 11 - Vulkan renderer (Forward+) - RTX 5090.

### Issue description

Howdy! I found this error when switching to thread model 2 in my game. It's seemingly the only race error I've spotted that came from Godot itself. It does not seem like this issue was fixed in Godot 4.7.1 based on the underlying code.

What happens is that in thread model 2, sometimes mucking around with text can cause the following error:
```cpp
ERROR: Condition "p_image.is_null() || p_image->is_empty()" is true.
   at: _texture_2d_update (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1591)
```

It happens even when no rendering code is involved. Simply changing a Label's text can cause it. I have reproduced it in the MRP. Forcing atlas growth can situationally race the render thread:

Not sure if it's related to #110296.


thread_model | errors in one ~10 s run
-- | --
2 (separate render thread) | 45
default (Safe) | 0

The number is random, it could be anywhere from 1 to 50.



### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP with the safe thread model as well as thread model 2 and note any errors you might see in thread model 2. It's a race condition, so it's hard to say whether it will easily happen on another person's machine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/ejektaflex/godot-mrp-font-atlas-thread-model

MRP TLDR GDScript:
```gd
# Forces continuous glyph-atlas growth. give the label characters it's never seen,
# so the TextServer keeps calling texture->update while the render thread runs. :)
extends Control

var code := 0x100  # goes up through Latin Extended and beyond
@onready var churn: Label = $Churn

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var s := ""
	for i in range(8):
		code += 1
		s += char(code)
	churn.text = churn.text + s
	if churn.text.length() > 400:
		churn.text = s
	if code > 0x2000:
		get_tree().quit()  # exit after maybe roughly 10 seconds
```
